title: Paris Police Deploy Tear Gas and Water Cannons Against Student Protesters
detail: Paris police deployed tear gas and water cannons against student protesters, marking an escalation in tactics after stun grenades were suspended. The incident signals growing tension between French authorities and student demonstrators.

media.caption: Paris police deploy tear gas and water cannons against student protesters

title: France Expels Two Nigerien Intelligence Agents in Diplomatic Incident
detail: France expelled two Nigerien intelligence agents in a diplomatic incident, per Le Monde reporting. The move reflects continued tensions between France and Niger following the 2023 coup and the breakdown of French-Nigerien relations.

title: France Struggles to Reassure Bond Markets as Asian Investors Drive Distrust
detail: France is struggling to reassure financial markets over its sovereign debt burden, with Asian investors emerging as a key driver of renewed distrust in French bonds. The deteriorating confidence reflects ongoing concerns about France's fiscal trajectory and its ability to manage its debt load amid European budgetary pressures.
